findings.summary: R1 milestone mapping includes M2 (Parallel Lane Execution) but R1 is an intake-level requirement that should be fully satisfied at M1 only

evidence.note: R1 maps to both M1 and M2, but R1 text specifies acceptance of plan_package_final.json as sole input, which is an Intake concern completed at M1
R1 requirement text focuses on input acceptance and rejection of non-canonical sources
evidence.quote: SHALL accept exactly one frozen plan_package_final.json (plus its associated structured handoff bundle) as its sole canonical planning input

findings.summary: R2 milestone mapping includes M2 (Parallel Lane Execution) but R2 is an intake-level prerequisite requirement that should be fully satisfied at M1 only

evidence.note: R2 maps to both M1 and M2, but R2 explicitly states repo_context.json SHALL be required before any code-generation stage begins, making it an M1 exit criterion only
R2 requirement text specifies repo_context.json must be present before code-generation
evidence.quote: SHALL be required before any code-generation stage begins
